summary_en: TX1 Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of Technopro Holdings, will launch a tender offer for all ordinary shares of Project Holdings at 2,200 yen per share and all warrant series for 1 yen each, from September 29 to November 11, 2026. The board recommended shareholder approval. The offer has a minimum acceptance threshold of 3,554,400 shares, representing 65.17% of voting rights.
title_en: Notice of Expression of Support and Recommendation for Tender Offer for Company Shares and Warrants by TX1 Corporation
translation_en_brief:
Project Holdings' board of directors approved the expression of support for a tender offer by TX1 Corporation, a wholly owned subsidiary of Technopro Holdings, on September 28, 2026. The offer covers all ordinary shares at 2,200 yen per share and seven series of warrants (warrant series 1 through 7) at 1 yen each warrant. The tender offer will run for 30 business days from September 29 to November 11, 2026.

The minimum acceptance threshold is 3,554,400 shares, which would result in TX1 Corporation owning 65.17% of voting rights after the acquisition, calculated based on 54,538 voting rights as of June 30, 2026, the most recent published figure. The board recommended that shareholders tender their shares. The purpose of the tender offer is to make Project Holdings a wholly owned subsidiary of TX1 Corporation, following which the company's shares are scheduled to be delisted from the Tokyo Growth Market.
